headlines.description: Dez Bryant caught four passes for 84 yards and the go-ahead touchdown in the fourth quarter, helping the Dallas Cowboys win their 11th straight game, 17-15 over the Minnesota Vikings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys hold on against Vikings for 11th straight win

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Eric Berry returned an interception for a TD, and then brought back another pick for a 2-point conversion that gave the Kansas City Chiefs an improbable 29-28 victory over the Atlanta Falcons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Berry's 2 picks carry Chiefs to 29-28 win over Falcons

headlines.description: Jordan Howard ran for 117 yards and a career-high three touchdowns and the Chicago Bears handed San Francisco its 11th straight loss, beating the 49ers 26-6 on a snowy Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Howard scores 3 TDs, Bears hand 49ers 11th loss in row 26-6

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw two touchdown passes and Cincinnati finally got its depleted offense moving without receiver A.J. Green, as the Bengals gave the Philadelphia Eagles their most lopsided loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton throws for 2 TDs, Bengals beat Eagles 32-14

events.name: Houston Texans at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for 209 yards and two touchdowns, and the Green Bay Packers pulled away from the Houston Texans with two fourth-quarter touchdowns for a 21-13 win Sunday to get back to .500.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers get back to .500, beat Texans 21-13

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady became the NFL's career leader in victories by a quarterback, earning his 201st by throwing for 269 yards and a touchdown to lead the New England Patriots past the Los Angeles Rams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady breaks QB wins record, Patriots beat Rams 26-10

events.name: Detroit Lions at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford passed for 341 yards and two touchdowns, and the Detroit Lions beat the mistake-prone New Orleans Saints, 28-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford throws for 341 yards, Lions beat Saints 28-13

headlines.description: Bradley Roby returned an interception 51 yards for a touchdown, helping the Denver Broncos beat the mistake-prone Jacksonville Jaguars 20-10 on Sunday and gain ground in the AFC playoff picture.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roby's Pick 6 helps Broncos beat Jaguars 20-10

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw for 381 yards and four touchdowns, and the Baltimore Ravens overwhelmed the Dolphins in the first half of a 38-6 victory Sunday that ended Miami's six-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco, Ravens end Dolphins' 6-game run with 38-6 rout

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw for 260 yards and two touchdowns to rally the Oakland Raiders to their biggest comeback in 16 years with a 38-24 victory over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr leads another rally for Raiders in 38-24 win over Bills

headlines.description: Carson Palmer threw for 300 yards and three touchdowns, David Johnson scored twice and the Arizona Cardinals held on to beat the Washington Redskins 31-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer, Johnson lead Cardinals past Redskins

events.name: New York Giants at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers ended the New York Giants' winning streak with a familiar formula.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers end Giants' winning streak at 6 in 24-14 victory

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw a go-ahead, 12-yard TD pass to Cameron Brate midway through the fourth quarter and Keith Tandy intercepted Philip Rivers in the end zone with 2:56 left to lift the Buccaneers
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston, Tandy lead Bucs to 4th straight win, 28-21 vs Bolts

headlines.description: Thomas Rawls ran for 103 yards and two touchdowns in the first half, Tyler Lockett took a reverse 75 yards for a score to open the second and the Seattle Seahawks routed the Carolina Panthers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thomas Rawls leads Seahawks to 40-7 pummeling of Panthers

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at New York Jets

headlines.description: Andrew Luck was nearly perfect in his return from a concussion, throwing for four touchdowns, three to Dwayne Allen, in the Indianapolis Colts' 41-10 romp Monday night over the New York Jets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck throws for 4 TDs, Colts rout Jets 41-10
